 Medicare open enrollment is underway for 2027 coverage 
 Expert advises reviewing plans in person with a licensed agent 
 2027 open enrollment (KELLY HUNT KNOE) By Kelly Hunt Published : Oct. 26, 2026 at 9:56 PM CDT | Updated : 19 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google MONROE, La. (KNOE) - Medicare open enrollment is underway, giving people a chance to review their health care coverage for 2027.
 With potential changes to premiums, prescription drug costs and plan benefits, experts said it’s important to understand options before making a decision.
 Agents advise reevaluating coverage
 Dee Dee Whitlock, senior market specialist with Senior Insurance Advisory Services, said a lot of Medicare Advantage plans did not renew.
 “There’s a lot of the Medicare Advantage plans that did not renew. So they’ll be sending out letters to each and every person who didn’t renew. But a lot of times they get a package and it’s a book about an inch thick. And a lot of them don’t pay attention to that. So I tell people you need to get with your agent to reevaluate your plans,” Whitlock said.
 Whitlock suggested speaking with a licensed agent in person, and not over the phone. She said local agents will help people find their best options.
